title: The effect of different types of attachment system in implant assisted over denture on rate of resorption of grafted anterior mandible (prospective clinical study)
authors: Nawar N, Sleem H. Egypt. J. Oral Maxillofac. Surg. 2020 Apr;11(2), 36 -43. doi : 10.21608/OMX.2020.29369.1063.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss Jason membrane (porcine pericardium) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “It could be concluded that resilient matrix (retention sil) for locator attachment induce less bone resorption than peek matrix in anterior grafted mandibular bone” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
